name: ibis Styles Serpong BSD City
short_description: A 4-star design-economy hotel that opened in 2024 in central BSD City, about 10 minutes from the ICE BSD convention center, with a game and karaoke room for families.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Serpong BSD City is a 4-star design-economy hotel at Kav Taman Kota Barat Lot II No 9 in BSD City, Serpong, that opened in early 2024 as one of the newest additions to the ibis family in Indonesia. The property centers on the strEATs restaurant serving Asian hawker and international cuisine, alongside a swimming pool, fitness center, and 6 meeting rooms including a 1,000 sqm largest space, with family-oriented touches like a game and karaoke room, bounce house, and foosball. It sits about 10 minutes from the ICE BSD convention center and roughly 3.5 km from Cisauk Railway Station. Accor's own listing shows a 4.6/5 ALL rating from over 640 reviews, and numerous independent 2024-2025 YouTube reviews consistently describe it as a new, family-friendly hotel with facilities well above its 3-star pricing tier, though it commands a slightly higher rate than some nearby ibis-brand properties.

faqs.question: When did ibis Styles Serpong BSD City open?
faqs.answer: It opened in early 2024 as one of the newest additions to the ibis family of hotels in Indonesia, per its own Accor listing and multiple independent YouTube reviews from that year. It sits in central BSD City, about 10 minutes from the ICE BSD convention center.

faqs.question: Is ibis Styles Serpong BSD City good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the hotel includes a dedicated game and karaoke room with arcade games, a bounce house, and foosball, alongside a swimming pool and fitness center, and multiple 2024-2025 independent reviews specifically praise its family-friendly facilities, describing amenities well above what its 3-star-equivalent pricing would suggest.
